result:
I verified round 92 and it **passes**: every browser check ran in real Chromium (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true) and I found no bugs. What the browser proves is that the anonymous `/studio-lab` demo output is unchanged. The new purchased-stems path is checked by unit tests only, because the purchased Studio route is still blocked by the auth owner.

- **Source:** I checked it at the start and end of my phase and nothing changed. HEAD is `77cd5b6`, there are 3 modified and 5 new files, and all 513 frozen files and the 10 protected files are unchanged. The diff touches only the lines B allowed, plus the two `fileStem` lines A disclosed. No route imports the new `collection.ts`. The demo texts were copied exactly from HEAD, not retyped.
- **Demo header text (1280×720 and 1440×900):** the heading, the demo badge, the ready status, the page title and the library notice all match exactly. Heading and badge each fit on one line inside the header and don't overlap the Master control. The server-rendered heading has no extra hydration comment, and no session logged a hydration warning or a real console error.
- **Load status (1440×900):** while I held back the `middle-east.mp3` download, the status showed the loading text. After release it showed the ready text 308 ms later. When I blocked `hero-music.mp3`, it showed exactly "1 source failed to load", and only that row showed an error.
- **Export file names:**
  - At 1280×720, a WAV of the whole project (101.702 s) downloaded as `czaba-studio-lab.wav`. A WAV of a 4–9 s selection downloaded as `czaba-studio-lab-range.wav` (exactly 240 000 frames).
  - At 1440×900, an MP3 of the whole project downloaded as `czaba-studio-lab.mp3`. Exporting the selection as both formats gave `czaba-studio-lab-range.wav` and `czaba-studio-lab-range.mp3`.
  - Every WAV is valid 24-bit, 48 kHz stereo, and every MP3 decodes at the right length. All completion messages match the round-91 texts.
- **Network:** no request went to R2, `/api/studio-token`, `/api/recording-*` or `/api/download`. No page request had an `Authorization` header, nothing loaded from unpkg before the first MP3 click, and the only audio fetched was the two demo files.
- **Purchase protection:** signed out, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. The header link opens the demo workspace.
- **Blocked:** the fake-token 403 check returned 500, because the backend isn't running in the cloud. It is listed as blocked, not passed.
- **Tests:** both new test files check exact values, fetch arguments and abort state, not just rendering. In my own scratch copy, mutation b (adding an `Authorization` header) failed PC3 and mutation f (hard-coding the demo file name) failed PW5, while the demo-lock test PW6 stayed green. The unmutated copy passed 20/20. A's targeted list passed: 68 files, 1126 tests.

Notes for B (no new bugs):
- No test covers the purchased MP3 file names; A already flagged this.
- The demo library shows the browser's raw English "Failed to fetch" when a file fails to load. This predates this round and could go in the low-priority batch.
- With an empty collection the status stays on "loading" (COLLECTION-EMPTY-STATUS). The new factory refuses empty input, so this only matters for a future provider fix.
- Every exported file peaks at full scale with this demo setup. Rounds 90–91 show the same, so it isn't caused by this round.

None of this round's behaviour has an Ableton equivalent. The full suite, typecheck, build, `npm run verify`, the e2e smoke run and the production bundle are left to the root gate.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-92.md
- c-round-92.json
- c-round-92/ (scripts, screenshots, measurements and the exported audio files)
